title: API Consumer Insights
description: API usage, latency and errors per endpoint, API key and query parameter for the demo APIs.

panels.title: Overview — calls, errors and latency for the selected APIs, consumers and endpoints
Total calls
panels.description: Number of calls in the selected time range.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Current request rate across the selection.

panels.title: Error rate (4xx + 5xx)
panels.description: Share of calls answered with a 4xx or 5xx, over the time range.

panels.title: Server errors (5xx)
panels.description: Share of calls that failed in the gateway or upstream (5xx).

panels.title: P95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile end-to-end latency (client → Tyk → upstream) over the time range.

panels.title: Active API keys
panels.description: Consumers (API key aliases) that made at least one call in the time range.

panels.title: Which endpoints are used most — grouped by API and by API key
Most-used endpoints
panels.description: Top endpoints by number of calls in the time range, across all selected API keys.

targets.expr: topk(12, label_join(label_join(label_replace(sum by (api_name, method, endpoint) (increase(tyk_consumer_requests_total{api_name=~"${api:regex}", consumer=~"${consumer:regex}", endpoint=~"${endpoint:regex}"}[$__range])), "api", "$1", "api_name", "(.*)"), "api_method", " · ", "api", "method"), "route", " ", "api_method", "endpoint"))

panels.title: Endpoint usage by API key
panels.description: Calls per endpoint (rows) for each API key / consumer (columns). Read across a row to see who uses an endpoint; down a column to see what a consumer calls.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_join(label_join(label_join(label_replace(sum by (api_name, method, endpoint, consumer, key_hash) (increase(tyk_consumer_requests_total{api_name=~"${api:regex}", consumer=~"${consumer:regex}", endpoint=~"${endpoint:regex}"}[$__range])), "api", "$1", "api_name", "(.*)"), "api_method", " · ", "api", "method"), "route", " ", "api_method", "endpoint"), "key", " (", "consumer", "key_hash"), "key", "$1)", "key", "(.+ \\(.+)"), "key", "$1", "key", "(.+) \\(")

panels.title: Endpoint traffic over time
panels.description: Request rate for the 8 busiest endpoints.

targets.expr: topk(8, label_join(label_join(label_replace(sum by (api_name, method, endpoint) (rate(tyk_consumer_requests_total{api_name=~"${api:regex}", consumer=~"${consumer:regex}", endpoint=~"${endpoint:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])), "api", "$1", "api_name", "(.*)"), "api_method", " · ", "api", "method"), "route", " ", "api_method", "endpoint"))

panels.title: Calls by API grouped by API key — compare consumers side by side
Calls per API by API key
panels.description: Number of calls for each API key (rows) on each API (columns). This is the view that is hard to get from per-key dashboards today (Q5).

panels.title: Share of calls by API key
panels.description: Each consumer's share of all calls in the time range.

panels.title: Calls by API key
panels.description: Total calls per API key in the time range.

panels.title: API key comparison scorecard
panels.description: One row per API key: volume, error rate, rate-limit and access denials, and latency — so keys can be compared directly instead of dashboard by dashboard.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_join(sum by (consumer, key_hash) (increase(tyk_consumer_requests_total{api_name=~"${api:regex}", consumer=~"${consumer:regex}", endpoint=~"${endpoint:regex}", response_code=~"[45].."}[$__range])) / sum by (consumer, key_hash) (increase(tyk_consumer_requests_total{api_name=~"${api:regex}", consumer=~"${consumer:regex}", endpoint=~"${endpoint:regex}"}[$__range])), "key", " (", "consumer", "key_hash"), "key", "$1)", "key", "(.+ \\(.+)"), "key", "$1", "key", "(.+) \\(")

label_replace(label_replace(label_join(count by (consumer, key_hash) (sum by (consumer, key_hash, api_name) (increase(tyk_consumer_requests_total{api_name=~"${api:regex}", consumer=~"${consumer:regex}", endpoint=~"${endpoint:regex}"}[$__range])) > 0), "key", " (", "consumer", "key_hash"), "key", "$1)", "key", "(.+ \\(.+)"), "key", "$1", "key", "(.+) \\(")

panels.title: Calls per second by API key
panels.description: Request rate per API key over time.

panels.title: Which query parameters are used across the endpoints
Query parameters in use
panels.description: Number of calls that carried each query parameter. Parameters are declared per instrument (context variables request_data_<name>) so cardinality stays bounded.

panels.title: Query parameters by endpoint
panels.description: Calls using each query parameter (columns), per endpoint (rows). Empty = parameter never sent to that endpoint.

targets.expr: label_join(label_replace(sum by (api_name, endpoint) (increase(tyk_consumer_query_params_total{api_name=~"${api:regex}", consumer=~"${consumer:regex}", endpoint=~"${endpoint:regex}", qp_status!=""}[$__range])), "api", "$1", "api_name", "(.*)"), "route", " · ", "api", "endpoint")

label_join(label_replace(sum by (api_name, endpoint) (increase(tyk_consumer_query_params_total{api_name=~"${api:regex}", consumer=~"${consumer:regex}", endpoint=~"${endpoint:regex}", qp_region!=""}[$__range])), "api", "$1", "api_name", "(.*)"), "route", " · ", "api", "endpoint")

label_join(label_replace(sum by (api_name, endpoint) (increase(tyk_consumer_query_params_total{api_name=~"${api:regex}", consumer=~"${consumer:regex}", endpoint=~"${endpoint:regex}", qp_site!=""}[$__range])), "api", "$1", "api_name", "(.*)"), "route", " · ", "api", "endpoint")

label_join(label_replace(sum by (api_name, endpoint) (increase(tyk_consumer_query_params_total{api_name=~"${api:regex}", consumer=~"${consumer:regex}", endpoint=~"${endpoint:regex}", qp_severity!=""}[$__range])), "api", "$1", "api_name", "(.*)"), "route", " · ", "api", "endpoint")

label_join(label_replace(sum by (api_name, endpoint) (increase(tyk_consumer_query_params_total{api_name=~"${api:regex}", consumer=~"${consumer:regex}", endpoint=~"${endpoint:regex}", qp_interval!=""}[$__range])), "api", "$1", "api_name", "(.*)"), "route", " · ", "api", "endpoint")

label_join(label_replace(sum by (api_name, endpoint) (increase(tyk_consumer_query_params_total{api_name=~"${api:regex}", consumer=~"${consumer:regex}", endpoint=~"${endpoint:regex}", qp_page!=""}[$__range])), "api", "$1", "api_name", "(.*)"), "route", " · ", "api", "endpoint")

label_join(label_replace(sum by (api_name, endpoint) (increase(tyk_consumer_query_params_total{api_name=~"${api:regex}", consumer=~"${consumer:regex}", endpoint=~"${endpoint:regex}", qp_limit!=""}[$__range])), "api", "$1", "api_name", "(.*)"), "route", " · ", "api", "endpoint")

panels.title: Region filter values
panels.description: Distribution of values sent in the 'region' query parameter.

panels.title: Project status filter values
panels.description: Distribution of values sent in the 'status' query parameter.

panels.title: Incident severity filter values
panels.description: Distribution of values sent in the 'severity' query parameter.

panels.title: Telemetry interval values
panels.description: Distribution of values sent in the 'interval' query parameter.

panels.title: Page size requested (limit) by API key
panels.description: Which API keys request large pages — a common source of slow calls and upstream load.

targets.expr: sum by (consumer, qp_limit) (increase(tyk_consumer_query_params_total{api_name=~"${api:regex}", consumer=~"${consumer:regex}", endpoint=~"${endpoint:regex}", qp_limit!=""}[$__range]))

panels.title: P95 latency by API
panels.description: 95th percentile end-to-end latency per API.

panels.title: P95 latency by API key
panels.description: 95th percentile latency per API key — shows which consumer experiences (or causes) slow calls.

panels.title: Slowest endpoints
panels.description: P50 / P95 / P99 latency per endpoint over the time range, slowest first.

panels.title: Where the time goes: gateway vs upstream (P95)
panels.description: Tyk's own processing time vs the backend's response time for the demo APIs (default Tyk instruments). A flat gateway line during a latency spike means the backend is the bottleneck.

panels.title: Error rate by API
panels.description: Share of calls answered 4xx/5xx, per API.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (api_name) (rate(tyk_consumer_requests_total{api_name=~"${api:regex}", consumer=~"${consumer:regex}", endpoint=~"${endpoint:regex}", response_code=~"[45].."}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (api_name) (rate(tyk_consumer_requests_total{api_name=~"${api:regex}", consumer=~"${consumer:regex}", endpoint=~"${endpoint:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])), "api", "$1", "api_name", "(.*)")

panels.title: Error rate by API key
panels.description: Share of calls answered 4xx/5xx, per API key.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_join(sum by (consumer, key_hash) (rate(tyk_consumer_requests_total{api_name=~"${api:regex}", consumer=~"${consumer:regex}", endpoint=~"${endpoint:regex}", response_code=~"[45].."}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (consumer, key_hash) (rate(tyk_consumer_requests_total{api_name=~"${api:regex}", consumer=~"${consumer:regex}", endpoint=~"${endpoint:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])), "key", " (", "consumer", "key_hash"), "key", "$1)", "key", "(.+ \\(.+)"), "key", "$1", "key", "(.+) \\(")

panels.title: Errors by status code
panels.description: 4xx/5xx responses per status code: 403 = key not allowed on that API, 404 = unknown path, 429 = rate limit, 5xx = gateway/upstream failure.

panels.title: Top failing calls
panels.description: Endpoint × API key × status code combinations with the most errors in the time range.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_join(topk(10, label_join(label_join(label_replace(sum by (api_name, method, endpoint, consumer, key_hash, response_code) (increase(tyk_consumer_requests_total{api_name=~"${api:regex}", consumer=~"${consumer:regex}", endpoint=~"${endpoint:regex}", response_code=~"[45].."}[$__range])), "api", "$1", "api_name", "(.*)"), "api_method", " · ", "api", "method"), "route", " ", "api_method", "endpoint")), "key", " (", "consumer", "key_hash"), "key", "$1)", "key", "(.+ \\(.+)"), "key", "$1", "key", "(.+) \\(")

panels.title: Calls per API
panels.description: Calls per minute for each API.

panels.title: Calls by status class
panels.description: Calls per minute by response class (2xx, 4xx, 5xx).

panels.title: Logs (Loki) — access logs for the demo APIs
Access-log volume by status
panels.description: Log lines per status code — the same signal from logs, no metrics needed.

panels.title: Failed calls (4xx / 5xx) — access logs
panels.description: Every failed call with its path, status, latency and hashed API key. Query strings are not logged by design (they can carry sensitive data).
